Practical firewood storage · Built on Site

Superior Standard Features

A purposeful firewood-storage structure with dependable framing, weather protection and traditional Appalachian character.

Foundation & Floor

4×6 pressure-treated foundation beams on 16×16×4-inch solid concrete support pads; final spacing and anchorage matched to the site and structure.

Framing & Roof

2×4 kiln-dried framing and model-specific engineered roof construction with a traditional 5/12 gable profile.

Accessible Firewood Storage

A practical open-front firewood-storage opening with a protective roof. The design shown is not a sealed, fully enclosed shed.

Exterior Siding

Roseburg DuraTemp standard siding, with LP SmartSide Vertical, Board & Batten, LP Lap and GP Vinyl Lap upgrade selections.

Roof & Weather Protection

½-inch CDX roof sheathing, architectural asphalt shingles, synthetic underlayment and appropriate roof flashing and ventilation details.

Built on Site

Constructed on your property. Additional site preparation beyond the included 6-inch leveling allowance is quoted in writing.

Helpful details

Frequently Asked Questions

Is the Appalachian Firewood Shed built on my property?

Yes. Every Appalachian Sheds structure is constructed on site. We review site access, placement and ground conditions before issuing a final written proposal.

What exterior siding is included?

Roseburg DuraTemp is included. Four siding upgrades are offered: LP SmartSide Vertical, LP SmartSide Board & Batten, LP SmartSide Lap and GP Vinyl Lap.

Is this an enclosed shed with doors?

The Firewood Shed design shown includes a large open-front firewood-storage opening. A fully enclosed shed or a different door design requires its own written proposal.

What if my desired size is not priced online?

All listed sizes are available for inquiry. Where an instant price is not displayed, we provide a written proposal based on the requested size and site.

Is painting or staining included?

Standard pricing does not include final painting or staining. Required exterior caulking and painting or staining must be completed within 30 days. ASI finishing services can be quoted separately.
